clause: Do not describe service levels as guaranteed; refer to the SLA.

response.text: Do not describe the uptime or other service levels as guaranteed; refer to the SLA instead. Delivery and response promises that are not part of the SLA may be stated plainly.
response.example_do: Replies are sent within four hours for priority tickets.
response.why: Reviewers often dismiss this rule for delivery and event promises, so the rule now says it covers service levels only.
